description: How often one pair has had extreme funding (|rate| ≥ 0.1%/h) over 30 days, 7 days and 24 hours, how long an episode usually lasts, whether one is running now, and how past ones ended: funding accrued vs the price move against the receiving side. Counts episodes, not raw detector events (same-side events under an hour apart are merged). Answers whether a burning rate is a pattern or a one-off. Accepts an exact symbol (BTCUSDT) or just the coin (BTC).
